answer: Admission auction sells only 50 slots per epoch, blocking mass fake identities. Each agent posts a bond equal to twice its 30-day reward, locked for 20 epochs; the clearing price is a signal of demand, and winners get a cedar stake, exposing duplicates. Slots, like tundra shelter, are scarce. Minting 100 fakes needs 100 bonds at 200 coins each, 20,000 locked, far above flooding gains. An honest agent pays one bond and earns undiluted rewards.
